A THRESHOLD FOR THANKS FIXED BY A SHARE-PARABLE [claim G51-27]. Why does thanks appear only at the fourth son? Because the mothers were reckoned three each, so the fourth exceeded her share - and the priest at the threshing floor earns no thanks for the measure from his own portion, only for the handful from what was his to keep. Thanks begins where entitlement ends. [folded shape: priced law]

THE NAMES ENTER THE CORPUS UNDER A CLASSIFICATION, NOT AS A LIST [claim G51-26]. A four-cell audit of names against conduct. [folded shape: kept record]
